pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patches on the central flank exhibit higher spatial area, while posterior and lower flank patches are significantly smaller and more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively constant across the mid-flank, thinning slightly toward the extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder ridge, corresponding to a dense mane. The edge shows consistent vertical pixel spikes against the background.
